title: From Facts to Folklore: Evaluating Large Language Models on Bengali Cultural Knowledge

bias_targets.methodology: Evaluating model performance (accuracy and MRR) on Question Answering and Masked Token Prediction tasks using the newly curated BLanCK dataset, comparing results between culturally-specific Bengali categories (e.g., food, religion, entertainment, historical) and non-cultural general categories (e.g., sports, economics, health).

Grouping dataset terms into buckets based on their normalized Wikipedia monthly page views and measuring how model accuracy correlates with the popularity of the entities to see if LLMs favor commonly accessed information.
